Cursor and subscription helpers add evidence, but the claimed roughly 300-line pipeline, debounce precedence, cache epochs and all loader error paths have not been reverified by the duplication pass. Do not mark the entire finding verified from these spans.

RunSummary and CurrentRunOutcomes share reconcile structure but differ in availability: run.valid? is required only by RunSummary. The inherited recommendation explicitly accepts availability/sameness callbacks, so this difference qualifies extraction rather than refuting the finding. Other presenters and health/reason vocabulary claims remain to be rechecked; preserve domain predicates.

Link all exact clusters to this existing finding instead of counting four new opportunities. These are four different policy sets: seeded vocabulary, agent write authorization, contradiction precedence, and provenance promotion. Adding a state does not necessarily require adding it to all four. The proposed vocabulary-minus-todo/merging/cancelled derivation includes canceled, which the current positive allowlist rejects. It would also authorize future vocabulary additions by default. Retain an explicit positive agent authorization policy. A shared provider-neutral lifecycle owner may expose separately named policies or explicit role metadata; do not derive write authority by subtracting a few disallowed states or make provider-neutral tools depend on a GitHub seeding adapter.

Fixing only Summaries terminal tags is insufficient. Canonical issue state should be distinct from label presentation. Bare-state normalization, TurnPrompt trim differences and separate active-state collection contracts remain as previously assessed.

The unconditional child declarations at src/lib/aiur.ex:312-313 corroborate relevance, but the probe does not load actual config, start the application or establish historical incidence.
